chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “The slave does not inherit, and the divorced person does not inherit.”

key_terms.الطَّلِيقُ: The divorced person; here, one excluded from inheritance after divorce.
key_terms.الْعَبْدُ: A slave; here, a person not entitled to inherit.
key_terms.يُوَرَّثُ: Is made to inherit; receives a share of inheritance.

ai.seo_question: Who is excluded from inheritance according to this hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning inheritance: neither a slave nor a divorced person inherits. It belongs to the jurisprudence of estate division and clarifies who is excluded from receiving inheritance shares.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5737 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab who said that Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"A slave does not inherit, and a divorced person does not inherit."
